Many Africans face payment processing hurdles, but there's a solution that puts you in control of your digital commerce stack. This guide shows you how to sell ebooks from Kenya using a blockchain-based payment system and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-what-actually-how-3|Cloudflare Workers]] infrastructure, eliminating the need for Stripe or other platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Ebooks kenya

Unlike traditional payment processors, blockchain-based payment systems like NOWPayments allow for cryptocurrency transactions that settle in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This is faster and cheaper than many traditional payment processors, and it's not limited by geographical restrictions. By using a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments, you can create a sovereign digital commerce stack that's not dependent on any single platform or country's regulations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves creating a NOWPayments account, which allows you to receive cryptocurrency payments, and setting up a file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You'll also need to create a storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and configure your payment pipeline to use NOWPayments. Don't worry if this sounds complicated - we'll walk you through each step in detail.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, follow these steps: create a NOWPayments account and configure it to receive naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, or other supported currencies; set up a file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; create a storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; and configure your payment pipeline to use NOWPayments. Make sure to test your payment pipeline thoroughly before going live to ensure that it's working correctly.
By using a blockchain-based payment system like NOWPayments, you can eliminate the need for traditional payment processors and enjoy faster and cheaper transactions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline are set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. To do this, simply upload your ebook to your storefront and set a price. When a customer buys your ebook, NOWPayments will automatically verify the payment and trigger the file delivery system to send the ebook to the customer. Make sure to keep an eye on your payments and analytics to ensure that everything is working correctly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is up and running, it's time to scale. To do this, you can upgrade your storefront to use Cloudflare Pages, which offers more advanced features and better performance. You can also configure your payment pipeline to use a more advanced payment processor, such as Binance P2P, which supports multiple currencies and has lower fees.
Where can I sell my eBook in Kenya?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks are not dependent on any single platform or country's regulations, giving you the freedom to create and sell digital products without restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in learning more about creating a sovereign digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can find more products and resources at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Additionally, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a 0.5% fee, making it a great option for creators looking to accept cryptocurrency payments.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: create a NOWPayments account and configure it to receive naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, or other supported currencies; set up a file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; create a storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; configure your payment pipeline to use NOWPayments; upload your ebook to your storefront and set a price; and test your payment pipeline thoroughly before going live.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a NOWPayments account?

To set up a NOWPayments account, simply go to the NOWPayments website and follow the instructions to create an account. You'll need to verify your email address and set up a payment method before you can start receiving payments.
What currencies does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. It also supports multiple fiat currencies, including naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and more.
Can I use Binance P2P with NOWPayments?

Yes, you can use Binance P2P with NOWPayments to receive payments in multiple currencies and lower fees. Binance P2P supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees, among other currencies.
How do I configure my payment pipeline to use NOWPayments?

To configure your payment pipeline to use NOWPayments, you'll need to set up a webhook to receive payment notifications and trigger the file delivery system to send the ebook to the customer. This involves configuring your storefront to use NOWPayments and setting up a file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
What happens if I encounter issues with my payment pipeline?

If you encounter issues with your payment pipeline, don't worry! NOWPayments has a customer support team that can help you troubleshoot and resolve any issues quickly. You can also refer to the NOWPayments documentation and tutorials for more information and guidance.
